quote: I visited Pensacola as part of CivicCon in 2018 and was impressed with the opportunities I saw. More recently, I was introduced to the Bluff Line by my friend and former colleague Matt Finn, who now lives and works in Pensacola. Along with Pavon Iyer, we discussed similarities with certain aspects of the Atlanta BeltLine as well as other projects we've worked on or researched across the country. We recognized the type of work that needs to be done, including big ideas that can attract additional support and funding to address transit, housing, and related opportunities. The vision outlined for the Bluff Line exemplifies the best use of these catalyst infrastructures.
author: Ryan Gravel
title: Urban planner; visionary behind the Atlanta BeltLine; Founder
